definitions.ask: How should the summary card's CODE section show the language breakdown?
definitions.why: Rows answer which language and which repo in the default view, matching the by-repo block

choices.label: Up to 4 bar rows under CODE, each naming the repos that hold it; card grows by at most 5 lines
One stacked language bar plus chips under CODE; repos appear only under g → language

definitions.ask: Should the repo grouping (-g repo / TUI By Repo) also gain a LANGUAGE column with each repo's top language?
definitions.why: Gives the repo view the inverse repo → language lookup for one extra column

choices.label: Wide layouts (≥100 cols) add '● Python 99%' after TESTS; it is the last detail column dropped
Repo table keeps its columns; language-per-repo lives on the card and under g → language
